budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town received a state asset management grant, described as roughly 78,000 dollars, to map physical infrastructure as an MS4 permit requirement.
budget_items.quote: this will be a roughly 78,000-dollar grant from the state and is a requirement of the ms4 permit by year 10.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: 20,000 dollars from the grant is to be encumbered to start the first two tasks for the Enterprise account.
budget_items.quote: encumbering 20,000 dollars from this grant will be used to start the first 2 tasks to create information for the enterprise account.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A new application for catch basin mapping was submitted; its cost was reduced because DEP is providing funding. No dollar figure is printed.
budget_items.quote: the cost has been reduced because dep is providing funding to accomplish this task.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The minutes describe a stormwater Enterprise account as having no competition for funding and typically sitting in the DPW budget. No dollar figure is printed.
budget_items.quote: the enterprise account is beneficial because there is no competition for funding and is typically already in the dpw budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Weekly man-hour tracking is expected to help calculate what is needed for capital funding. No dollar figure is printed.
budget_items.quote: this tracking will help calculate what we need for capital funding.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The chair wants a way to better track where stormwater dollars are being spent. No dollar figure is printed.
budget_items.quote: todd dwyer wants to look into a way to better track where the stormwater dollars are being expended.
